title: Local Search and Optimization
overview: Optimize objective functions by moving through neighboring states, without tracking full paths.
objectives: Implement hill climbing and recognize local maxima
Describe selection, crossover, and mutation in genetic algorithms

method.title: Hill climbing
method.body: Repeatedly moves to the best neighbor and stops at a peak, which may only be a local optimum.

method.title: Random restarts
method.body: Running hill climbing from many starting points raises the chance of finding a global optimum.

method.title: Simulated annealing
method.body: Accepts worse moves with probability exp(-delta/T) and lowers T over time, allowing escape from local optima.

method.title: Genetic algorithms
method.body: Maintain a population evolved through fitness-based selection, crossover, and mutation.

pseudocode:
state = random_state()
for step in range(N):
    nxt = random_neighbor(state)
    delta = value(nxt) - value(state)
    if delta > 0 or random() < exp(delta / T):
        state = nxt
    T = cool(T)

playground.starterCode:
def f(x): return -(x-3)**2 + 9
x = 0.0
for _ in range(100):
    best = max([x-0.1, x, x+0.1], key=f)
    if best == x: break
    x = best
print(round(x,1), round(f(x),1))
